name: vector-qr-studio
description: A fully static QR code generator powered by Rust WebAssembly and Vite.

scripts.wasm: rm -rf src/wasm/pkg && wasm-pack build wasm/qr-engine --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg --release
scripts.wasm:dev: rm -rf src/wasm/pkg && wasm-pack build wasm/qr-engine --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg --dev
